sign_only.our_definition: daylighting in scope with hardened = no, being a curb regulation sign order and no object in the cleared space

hardened.our_definition: daylighting in scope with hardened = yes, every device, which is the arm DOT splits into its five device rows

citibike.reason: the inventory holds 5 bikeshare records; the 5 that carry a day date are dated 2025, so none of them can be placed inside 2019 to 2021

bike_corral.reason: the inventory holds 2858 corral_bike records; 2833 of them carry no install date at all; the 25 that carry a day date are dated 2025, so none of them can be placed inside 2019 to 2021

hardened_from_turn_calming.our_definition: daylighting in scope with hardened = yes whose record comes from the turn calming inventory, which is DOT's own definition of this row

turn_calming_all_family.our_definition: treatment_family = turn_calming, the whole inventory whether or not the corner was daylit, which is a superset of DOT's row

neckdown.reason: no published inventory of neckdowns could be located

enhanced_crosswalk.reason: no published inventory of enhanced crosswalks could be located

hardened_composition.read_as: the two hardened arms carry the same name and different objects, so the hardened row of the comparison table is not a like for like contrast even where the two figures agree

treatment_list.what: DOT's list of 756 intersections installed 2019 to 2021 is not published, so our sample is reconstructed from sign orders, the escooter corral inventory and the turn calming inventory
treatment_list.read_as: the ratio of our unit count to theirs, by subgroup; a ratio away from 1 means the two analyses are estimating on different samples of the same programme and the difference between the two figures cannot be attributed to method

intervention_exclusion.what: DOT excluded any location carrying an Open Street, a hardened daylighting treatment, a No Standing Anytime sign, a protected bike lane or a Street Improvement Project installed during the analysis, from both groups. Our comparison locations are screened against every treatment family we hold, at any date, which is a stricter screen on that side. Our treated units are not screened at all, which is a looser screen on this side. Open Streets and protected bike lanes are not held in any form.
intervention_exclusion.read_as: the share of our treated units that DOT would have excluded on the part of their screen we can apply, and the estimate with and without that exclusion; the gap between the two is the measurable part of this mismatch and the Open Street and bike lane part remains unmeasurable

attribution_radius.what: DOT does not state the distance within which an injury belongs to an intersection
attribution_radius.read_as: the range of our estimate over radii of 15, 30, 50 m; the width of that range is what the unstated radius costs the comparison

missing_subgroups.what: four of their seven rows cannot be reproduced, two for want of any inventory and two for want of a date

consequence.bike_corral: the inventory holds 2858 corral_bike records; 2833 of them carry no install date at all; the 25 that carry a day date are dated 2025, so none of them can be placed inside 2019 to 2021
consequence.neckdown: no published inventory of neckdowns could be located
consequence.enhanced_crosswalk: no published inventory of enhanced crosswalks could be located

missing_subgroups.read_as: a row that cannot be reproduced is not a disagreement with DOT; it is a statement about what the city publishes

no_placebo_published.what: DOT reports no test of whether its arithmetic returns an effect on months when nothing was built
no_placebo_published.read_as: a subgroup whose placebo does not cover zero was already diverging from its comparison locations before construction, so neither our figure nor DOT's measures the treatment there

daylighting_hardened_at_junction.why: The published hardened row and this subset both name a physical object in the cleared space. They hold different objects: the published row is Citi Bike docks, bike corrals, turn calming, neckdowns and enhanced crosswalks, and this subset is scooter corrals, rubber speed bumps and bike islands.

daylighting_signage_at_junction.why: Both name daylighting by sign order and paint with no object in the cleared space. The published row holds 567 locations installed 2019 to 2021 and this subset holds every such record the inventory carries inside the admissible installation span.

turn_calming_all.why: The published turn calming row is the turn calming part of the hardened daylighting arm, being 33 locations. This subset is the whole turn calming inventory, which is a superset of it, so the two figures rest on different samples of the same programme.

coverage_note: The published specification reports six cells, being two outcomes over three arms that this study can reconstruct, together with five device rows inside the hardened arm. It reports nothing for the other subsets, so most rows of the table carry no first column group. Its two outcomes are injuries to people: pedestrian injuries, which is the outcome inj_ped here, and injuries of every kind, which is none of the five outcomes here because the other four count crash events.
